payload.name: Compress PDF to 200KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup PDF compressor for strict 200KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based PDF compressor for strict 200KB upload limits on application forms, exam portals, school uploads, and admin pages. It opens the local PDF compressor with a 200KB target, keeps ordinary files on the device during use, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
